name: Otohime Ayako
source:
She has been working as Sawatari's secretary since she joined the company three years ago.

She is a woman of talent and beauty, but she has been under Sawatari's lewd training since she joined the company, and she has already become unable to live without his humiliating acts.

While performing her normal duties with excellence, Sawatari also violates her voluptuous body both on and off the job.

She helps train Kaori, an apprentice secretary, but fears that Sawatari's distorted affection for her will lead her away from him, and she is intensely jealous of Kaori.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/reizokuhisyo/index.html]official site[/url]]
